SELECT u.id, u.name, u.region_id, r.name AS region_name, u.road_address, u.latitude, u.longitude, u.current_status, u.current_risk_level, rs.risk_score, u.flood_history_count, u.created_at, COALESCE(pr.pending_count, 0) AS pending_review_count, COALESCE(rc.remaining_count, 0) AS remaining_count FROM underpass u LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = u.region_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rs2.risk_score FROM risk_score rs2 WHERE rs2.underpass_id = u.id ORDER BY rs2.predicted_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) rs ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM plate_log p JOIN underpass_camera c ON c.id = p.camera_id WHERE c.underpass_id = u.id AND p.review_status = 'PENDING' ) pr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_count FROM underpass_transit t WHERE t.underpass_id = u.id AND t.status = 'REMAINING' ) rc ON TRUE
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, name, region_id, road_address, latitude, longitude, height_m, length_m, flood_history_count, current_status, current_block_event_id, current_risk_level, entry_camera_id, exit_camera_id, created_at FROM underpass WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO underpass (name, region_id, road_address, latitude, longitude, height_m, length_m, flood_history_count, current_status) VALUES (#{name}, #{regionId}, #{roadAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{heightM}, #{lengthM}, #{floodHistoryCount}, #{currentStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE underpass SET name = #{name}, region_id = #{regionId}, road_address = #{roadAddress}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, height_m = #{heightM}, length_m = #{lengthM}, flood_history_count = #{floodHistoryCount} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE underpass SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
